title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE PLACING THE COUNCIL OF INTERFAITH INITIATIVES UNDER THE NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL
title.orig: MALACAÑAN PALACE PLACING THE COUNCIL OF INTERFAITH INITIATIVES UNDER THE NATIONAL SECURITY COUNCIL

text.en:
The Council of Interfaith Initiatives (CII) shall be placed under the
oversight of the National Security Council;
The National Security Adviser shall be the Vice-Chair of the CII;

All issuances inconsistent with this order are hereby repealed or
amended accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 6th day of November in the Year of Our Lord, Two
Thousand and Nine.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
